tests.case: Unlinked_source_entries_keep_their_identity_figures_and_bucket_over_HTTP
renders each unlinked source entry separately with its own title total and store

LibraryGrainTests.An_unlinked_library_is.reason: The original four Prey/Prey/Dishonored/Hades entries retain their ownership, release and work IDs, minutes, dates and buckets across the production API. Both Electron Library presentations render all four separately with their own headline and single-store chip, without a grouped-store mark.

tests.case: Linked_pairs_keep_primary_order_and_every_original_member_identifier
keeps linked copies in one tile with exactly their distinct store words and resting initials

LibraryGrainTests.A_linked_pair_is_one_t.reason: A real same-game link preserves the primary Prey name and both Steam/Epic member identities. Both renderers show one Prey plus one Dishonored tile, exactly STEAM/EPIC chips and S/E initials for the grouped tile, and no resting mark on Dishonored. Desktop list rows preserve the same two-store vocabulary and two-game count.

tests.case: Repeated_store_licences_remain_distinct_entries_in_one_game
deduplicates repeated licences case insensitively without dropping any entries

LibraryGrainTests.Chips_list_every_store.reason: The source Steam/Steam/GOG group retains three entries through HTTP. Both Electron modes emit exactly two chips and two initials, preserve first-entry order, and also verify mixed-case store identifiers deduplicate without losing ownership IDs.

tests.case: Group_totals_sum_minutes_and_choose_the_latest_date_without_crossing_entry_facts
carries the grouped 340-minute headline and summed bucket through Library cuts

LibraryGrainTests.The_headline_sums_and_.reason: The production grouping boundary checks the original 300-minute/400-day Steam and 40-minute/10-day Epic fixture: 340 minutes and the 10-day group date while each entry retains its own pair. Both surfaces render the aggregate headline; dormancy separately verifies the renderer consumes the group date.

tests.case: Group_bucket_is_classified_from_the_sum_even_when_each_copy_is_below_the_refund_line
carries the grouped 340-minute headline and summed bucket through Library cuts

LibraryGrainTests.The_bucket_of_a_cross_.reason: The exact two 70-minute source entries are Active separately but their 140-minute HTTP group is Bounced, equal to LibraryBucketRules.Classify over the group facts. The renderer consumes that supplied bucket; both modes keep a Bounced group in Started and exclude it from Never played.

tests.case: Recent_play_on_a_secondary_store_becomes_the_group_date
uses the grouped total and latest date for headline and dormancy while leaving copy facts intact

LibraryGrainTests.Dormancy_follows_the_g.reason: The original four-year-old Steam/2-day-old Epic pair yields the recent group date and 310 minutes over HTTP. Both cover components use that date for a measurably brighter dormancy style than the Steam-only cover while preserving each copy's own facts.

tests.case: keeps linked copies in one tile with exactly their distinct store words and resting initials
grouped store marks fit the cover and preserve store names with reduced motion

LibraryGrainTests.The_automation_name_di.reason: Both surfaces expose Steam and Epic in the grouped cover's accessible name; desktop list does too. The existing View action prefix remains for all Electron tiles, while the Owned on sentence distinguishes multi-store games. Initials are redundant and aria-hidden. Native checks measure initial-mark containment, fallback-title separation, desktop hover/focus replacement and fullscreen persistence, with and without reduced motion.

tests.case: Linked_pairs_keep_primary_order_and_every_original_member_identifier
routes linked release %s from Home to its grouped game identity
opens the same grouped game from either member ownership in %s Activity

LibraryGrainTests.A_collapsed_tile_answe.reason: The production API preserves all member ownership/release identities and lookups over its grouped result find the same game. Both Electron Home surfaces resolve each original release to the primary Prey identity; both Activity surfaces resolve each original ownership to that same identity and open it. The member display name never becomes an extra tile or a different Details destination.

tests.case: Details_reads_major_updates_from_a_secondary_release_and_preserves_its_ownership
keeps grouped Prey selection totals secondary updates and the installed Epic action together on %s

LibraryGrainTests.The_modal_lists_update.reason: Production HTTP checks the original secondary-Epic build/announcement fixture, group StaleButPatched bucket, both member identities and both update events. The composed App regression selects the grouped tile, asserts its unread badge, opens Details and verifies the secondary release's build and announcement in Updates on both surfaces.

tests.case: keeps grouped Prey selection totals secondary updates and the installed Epic action together on %s
opens keyboard-selected Details only on activation and preserves the selection on close

LibraryGrainTests.Selection_keyboard_and.reason: Both composed surfaces select Dishonored, move right to the grouped Prey, clamp at the last game, and keep that selection after closing Details. Tile and Details use the same original compact 6h total for 390 minutes. Details names both stores and its Library panel exposes both owned copies. Native keyboard activation and close-time selection preservation are checked independently with real buttons.

tests.case: fills the original desktop wall width %s at density %s with whole-pixel cells and no lost column
uses whole-pixel cells and removes only complete rows without a trailing gutter

LibraryGrainTests.A_row_of_the_wall_fill.reason: The exact eight source width/density pairs preserve at least one column, used width no greater than available width, less than one pixel slack per column plus one, 16px gutters and floor(width*1.5) heights. Native measurement verifies actual integer CSS cells and no lost column at two window sizes and all three density settings. Fullscreen retains its separate two-row geometry.

tests.case: collapsing 1012 to 1011 games at width %s and density %s removes only whole rows with no trailing gap
uses whole-pixel cells and removes only complete rows without a trailing gutter

LibraryGrainTests.Fewer_tiles_shortens_t.reason: All three original width/density pairs compare 1012 and 1011 items, verify a zero-or-one-row change and exact row-height-plus-gutter difference, and cover empty/single-item extents. Native virtualized grids verify both counts, last-cover bottom equal to wall bottom without a trailing gutter, one-row height for one game, and no wall for an empty library.

tests.case: counts a list holding both linked releases once and moves a grouped tile by its secondary member

LibraryGrainTests.A_list_holding_both_en.reason: Both composed Library surfaces open a Co-op night list containing the Steam and Epic releases of Prey and render exactly one grouped game with a displayed count of one. The unrelated Dishonored game remains outside the list.

tests.case: counts a list holding both linked releases once and moves a grouped tile by its secondary member

LibraryGrainTests.A_collapsed_tile_sorts.reason: The original Prey/Dishonored list is held by Prey's secondary Epic release. Both modes use list order, start with Prey first, disable Move earlier and enable Move later, send the observed revision plus [Dishonored release, Epic release], and render Dishonored first after publication while keeping the list open.

tests.case: keeps grouped Prey selection totals secondary updates and the installed Epic action together on %s
Details_reads_major_updates_from_a_secondary_release_and_preserves_its_ownership

LibraryGrainTests.Play_acts_on_the_copy_.reason: The API preserves the installed secondary ownership in a Steam-primary/Epic-secondary group. On desktop and fullscreen, activating the composed Details Play button sends actions.execute for installed Epic ownership 2 and never Steam ownership 1. Both per-copy controls remain available in Library.
